# 2026-11-02

## Lisbon trip planning

- Flights booked for 12–17 December, window seats.
- Stay in Alfama, close to the viewpoints.
- Ride tram 28 early in the morning before the crowds.
- Day trip to Sintra by train from Rossio station.
- Try the custard tarts at the bakery in Belém.

## Budget

About 900 in total, taken from the travel line of [[budget-2026]].
